The retained record shows holding-window tip speeds of 0.6351726092425104-1.5810152739742807 m/s against a 0.02 m/s limit, but a single execution and raw weight magnitudes do not establish that the tip-speed weight terms would change the sampled holding result. attribution.reason: The recorded window speed range minimum alone (0.6351726092425104 m/s) exceeds the 0.02 m/s settling limit, and holding_speed_passed / sampled_settling_passed / joint_reach_holding_passed are all false. This characterises the failed area; it does not identify why the speed remained high.

Terminal reach passing (terminal_error_m = 0.007642608585867386 m inside reach_tolerance_m = 0.01 m) coexists with a sampled window error maximum of 0.05813810428573256 m and a sampled row at 0.03407510504995951 m, so the terminal instant is the low end of the sampled window rather than its representative value.

Recorded wall-clock computation is large relative to the 0.01 s control period (mean_update_s = 17.26331904856488 s; solve times about 15 s; update_wall_s up to 29.352235099999234 s) and every recorded update is counted as a deadline miss. Because the scheduler is synchronous, this supports only a wall-clock overrun observation, not skipped simulated updates and not a proven cause of the sampled holding failure.

Sampled updates return before convergence with optimization_raw_status = User_Requested_Stop near solve times close to the feasible_return budget_s = 15.0 s, with policy_stop_reason budget_best_feasible and relative_seed_improvement and effective_horizon as low as 5 control intervals; whether these returns degraded the applied plans or the sampled holding result cannot be settled from these facts (full warm plans and iteration traces are not retained).

Explicitly excluded: the inventory records no closed-loop counterfactual replay or causal attribution tool (capabilities.unsupported includes causal_identification), the motion view shows only the final window, and this is a single execution, so no dominant cause can be identified from the retained facts.

Recorded tip speed over the six final holding-window samples spans 0.6351726092425104 m/s to 1.5810152739742807 m/s (holding_window_summary.ranges.speed_m_s minimum and maximum; late_max_speed_m_s = 1.5810152739742807 m/s). For the 35 recorded updates, deadline_misses = 35 and mean_update_s = 17.26331904856488 s against control_period_s = 0.01 s. Prediction-view reads cover controller updates 0-34 in five batches (8, 8, 8, 8 and 3 updates), and the derived per-interval records include measured tip speeds of 0.4763332930446316 m/s (update 10), 0.4856871422589636 m/s (update 12), 0.4310497806708031 m/s (update 17) and 0.3864852248913558 m/s (update 19); the 8-row selected prediction summary (endpoint times 0.17-0.24 s, measured-speed count 8) records a measured-speed maximum of 0.4497162302695522 m/s. These mid-trajectory sampled speeds are lower than the 0.6351726092425104-1.5810152739742807 m/s range recorded in the final holding window, and full_snapshots_available = false.

limitations: Coverage: the motion view displays only the final settling window (t = 0.30-0.35 s, 6 samples); full_snapshots_available = false; full historical warm plans and optimizer iteration traces are not retained.
Selected endpoints are not the full trajectory: per-interval measured tip speeds cited here are individual matched endpoint samples drawn from the prediction views, not whole-trajectory ranges.
Wall-clock update durations come from a synchronous scheduler; they show wall overruns and do not by themselves establish skipped simulated updates or an effect on settling.

The holding-window summary reports per-channel ranges; paired per-row (error, speed) pairs are not displayed in this context, so co-variation across the six rows is not determinable from displayed content.
Raw weight magnitudes do not establish cost-term importance without actual contributions or scaling; this report makes no configuration or winning-weight claim.
Terminal reach, sampled holding position, sampled holding speed and computation are reported separately and are not established as causally linked.
